name: io.github.reeinharddd/snapmcp
description: Visual capture MCP server: terminal colors, code, diffs, PDFs, GIFs. 13 tools, SSRF on by default.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_THEME
environmentVariables.description: Shiki syntax highlighting theme (27 built-in themes, auto-detected terminal theme when unset)

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Output image format: png or jpeg

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_QUALITY
environmentVariables.description: JPEG quality (1-100, only used for JPEG)

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_SHADOW
environmentVariables.description: Drop shadow level: none, soft, medium, strong

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated allowlist of file paths readable by capture_file (deny-all when unset)

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_SSRF_PROTECTION
environmentVariables.description: Block requests to private IP ranges (DNS-resolved, IPv4 + IPv6). Default: true

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_CHROME_EXECUTABLE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a system Chrome/Chromium binary to use for browser captures

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_CHROME_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Chrome profile directory to use for browser captures (persistent context)

list.name: capture_terminal
list.description: Terminal output with syntax-colored prompts (auto-detects real terminal theme)

list.name: capture_code
list.description: Syntax-highlighted code via Shiki (50+ languages, 27 themes)

list.name: capture_browser
list.description: Full-page or viewport screenshot of a URL

list.name: capture_file
list.description: File to auto-detected language syntax-highlighted screenshot

list.name: capture_markdown
list.description: Rendered markdown as a styled document

list.name: capture_html
list.description: Arbitrary HTML snippet rendered as image

list.name: capture_diff
list.description: Git diffs with green additions / red deletions

list.name: capture_batch
list.description: Batch capture multiple items in a single call
